theater: 小亞細亞、奇里乞亞與希臘

battle.name: 第二次米特拉達梯戰爭
battle.theater: 小亞細亞、奇里乞亞與希臘
battle.brief: 西元前八十八年，羅馬執政官蘇拉接手對本都王米特拉達梯六世的戰事，在奇里乞亞、卡帕多西亞與希臘連戰：提格拉河之戰破了提格拉涅斯與米氏的聯軍，希臘方面又自比雷埃夫斯登陸奪回雅典。卡面的羅馬方陣盾是這場戰役的骨幹——凸面長方盾沿盾緣咬合成牆，正是它頂住龐提亞的卡爾基斯方陣。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries:
交戰方是羅馬共和國與本都王國聯軍這兩大集團，第三方則是捲入的亞美尼亞、希臘城邦與小亞細亞的割據王國。羅馬方面由元老院與公民大會授權執政官出征：前八十九年由昆圖斯·凱基利奧斯·梅特盧斯（後稱「虔敬者」）率兩個軍團赴安納托利亞，前八十八年改由盧基里烏斯·科爾奈利奧斯·蘇拉執掌東戰線，前八十五年起再交給盧基里烏斯·李奇尼烏斯·盧庫魯斯。羅馬野戰軍由公民軍團與數量相當的輔助軍組成，輔助軍以盟邦高盧、西班牙、迦太基與希臘城邦的部隊為主；元老院另外維持海軍，負責黑海與愛琴海的制海權與糧運。羅馬一方的盟邦包括卡帕多西亞王阿里奧巴匝涅斯、比提尼亞王尼科米德四世、帕加馬的歐梅尼斯二世，以及在愛琴海支持羅馬的羅得島；蘇拉出戰時還自意大利各行省抽調援軍、輔助兵與糧船隨軍。

本都方面以米特拉達梯六世為核心，他控制的疆土從黑海南岸的本都——辛諾普、阿米索斯、特拉佩祖斯、科提奧拉——延伸到帕夫拉戈尼亞、加拉梯亞與奇里乞亞，並以黑海沿岸卡律布斯的鐵礦與造船木材作為戰爭資源。聯軍的另一根支柱是亞美尼亞王提格拉涅斯二世，他以提格拉諾塞達為都，握有上美索不達米亞、索利與奇里乞亞，最有價值的兵力是成建制的亞美尼亞重騎兵。米特拉達梯另以現金僱用希臘與馬其頓式的方陣步兵、色雷斯標槍手、伊比利亞與奇里乞亞的弓箭手、投石手，以及加拉梯亞的雙刃長刀戰士，並以克里米翁與塞浦路斯水手組成帶火船與投石機的艦隊。在希臘本土，他扶植雅典的阿里斯托尼翁與底比斯的查爾刻斯，試圖把戰爭轉成反羅馬的希臘解放運動。
countriesEn: The two principal belligerents were the Roman Republic on one side and a Pontic-led coalition on the other, with a third layer made up of Armenia, the Greek city states and the client kingdoms of Asia Minor. On the Roman side the Senate and the popular assembly authorised the consuls to take the field: Quintus Caecilius Metellus, known as Pius, was sent to Anatolia with two legions in 89 BC; in 88 BC the eastern command passed to Lucius Cornelius Sulla; from 85 BC it passed again to Lucius Licinius Lucullus. A Roman field army combined citizen legions with auxiliaries in comparable numbers, drawn mainly from allied Gauls, Spaniards, Carthaginians and Greek communities, and the Senate separately maintained a navy responsible for the Black Sea and Aegean sea control and for the grain route. Rome's allies included Ariobarzanes, king of Cappadocia, Nicomedes IV of Bithynia, Eumenes II of Pergamon, and Rhodes, which backed Rome in the Aegean; Sulla also drew reinforcements, auxiliaries and grain ships from the Italian provinces. On the Pontic side the core was Mithridates VI, whose territory ran from the Black Sea coast of Pontus — Sinope, Amisus, Trapezus, Cotyora — through Paphlagonia, Galatia and Cilicia, and whose resources included the iron of the Chalybes on the shore of the Black Sea and the timber for shipbuilding. The coalition's other pillar was Tigranes II of Armenia, whose capital was Tigranocerta and who held Upper Mesopotamia, Sophene and Cilicia, the most valuable single arm he brought being massed Armenian heavy cavalry. Mithridates also bought troops with the revenues of his Black Sea ports: Greek and Macedonian-style phalanx infantry, Thracian peltasts, Iberian and Cilician archers, slingers, and Galatian infantry with their long two-edged swords, plus a fleet of Hellenic and Cypriot sailors equipped with fire-ships and artillery. On the Greek mainland he supported Aristion at Athens and Charicles at Thebes, hoping to turn the war into a Greek war of liberation against Rome.
people:
關鍵人物分屬兩邊。米特拉達梯六世在位四十餘年，少年時已隨使節團滯留羅馬並廣交希臘學者；前八十八年他接手父位與龐提亞的戰爭機器，先以「王位繼承」的名義逐出卡帕多西亞王阿里奧巴匝涅斯，把兩個兒子馬卡里亞斯與米特拉達梯·斐羅帕托爾分別立為卡帕多西亞與提格拉諾塞達的國王，再把加爾比斯、奇里乞亞的港口與島嶼收進版圖。他與蘇拉兩度通書，欣賞蘇拉的才幹；和約破裂後，他仍企圖以希臘戰場與黑海封鎖拖垮羅馬。提格拉涅斯二世是聯軍中最具規模的軍力來源，他以女兒嫁給米特拉達梯，兩國聯軍在奇里乞亞會師，亞美尼亞騎兵在提格拉河一役中全軍潰散，之後提格拉涅斯退回本土再未與羅馬正面交鋒。

蘇拉是本戰役的樞紐。他前八十八年以執政官身分出使東方，返國後接管戰事，率軍向羅馬進逼以取得元老院的讓步，隨後在同年冬天進軍奇里乞亞，在提格拉河擊破聯軍。開戰初期被龐提亞將軍阿卡勞斯壓制的梅特盧斯，未能取得決定性成果；盧庫魯斯在最後兩年把戰場推入本都內陸，奪取黑海西岸的山地要塞，把米特拉達梯從進攻逼成逃亡。希臘方面，雅典的阿里斯托尼翁曾迎米特拉達梯的駐軍入城，最後死在衛城；底比斯的將軍查爾刻斯在查里刻戰役中戰敗被俘。米特拉達梯的長子馬卡里亞斯在談判破裂後自殺，次子馬卡尼達斯隨父逃往科爾喀斯，後來在第三次米特拉達梯戰爭中成為弒父者。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities fall into two camps. Mithridates VI of Pontus reigned for more than forty years; as a boy he had stayed in Rome in the entourage of an embassy and mixed freely with Greek scholars, and by 88 BC he had taken over both the throne and the war effort of Pontus, first expelling Ariobarzanes of Cappadocia in the name of a disputed succession, then installing his two sons, Macharias and Mithridates Philopator Philadelphus, as kings of Cappadocia and of Tigranocerta, and finally taking Albia, the Cilician ports and the islands into his own hands. He exchanged letters with Sulla and openly admired his talents, and when the negotiations collapsed he still hoped to grind Roman resources down through a Greek war and a Black Sea blockade. Tigranes II of Armenia was the coalition's heaviest single force; he married his daughter to Mithridates, the two states' armies met in Cilicia, and the Armenian cavalry was routed in the battle at the Tigris, after which Tigranes withdrew into his own highlands and never again faced Rome in the open field. Sulla was the hinge of the whole campaign: as consul in 88 BC he had gone east as an ambassador, on his return he took over the command and marched on Rome to compel the Senate's compliance, and then in the winter of that same year he carried the war into Cilicia and broke the coalition at the Tigris. Metellus Pius, the first commander, had been held in check by the Pontic general Archelaus and achieved nothing decisive. Lucullus, who took over in 85 BC, drove the war into the interior of Pontus, took the mountain strongholds of the western Black Sea coast, and turned Mithridates from attacker into fugitive. On the Greek side Aristion, who had admitted a Mithridatic garrison into Athens, died on the Acropolis; Charicles, the Theban general, was taken prisoner after the defeat at Charicea. Mithridates' elder son Macharias killed himself when his negotiations collapsed, and the younger, Machanidas, fled with his father to Colchis and would later become his father's killer.
kits:
卡面的羅馬方陣盾（scutum）是這場戰爭裝備體系的樞紐。共和國末期重裝步兵的標準盾牌已由早期那面小圓盾換成長方微凸的盾形：木製夾層板面，外加鐵邊與中央鐵突，尺寸約高一公尺、寬六十至七十五公分，重量約六至八公斤。它掛在左前臂，右臂留給標槍與短劍；盾身微微彎曲，列陣時相鄰者的盾緣互相咬合，前排因此合成一道可以承擔衝撞的連續盾牆，後排的標槍手再越過盾線投擲。共和國晚期的野戰軍仍以「中隊」（manipulus）為基本單位，每中隊由兩個百人隊組成、各約六十人，一中隊約一百二十人，每軍團十個中隊，傳統編制另有約三千步兵與三百至六百騎兵，實戰時百人隊常以八十人湊成；甲胄以鎖子甲（lorica hamata）為主，分段式板甲要到一世紀後才成為標準配備。

對手這邊的裝備完全是希臘化體系。米特拉達梯的方陣步兵以薩里沙長矛（sarma，約二至二點四公尺）配小圓盾作戰，最前面是卡爾基斯方陣，配六公尺長矛與小盾，排成多排密集縱隊前推。龐提亞另雇色雷斯標槍手、伊比利亞與奇里乞亞弓箭手、投石手與加拉梯亞的雙刃長刀戰士；其艦隊以克里米翁與塞浦路斯水手組成，配有火船與艦載投石機。攻城方面，蘇拉在奇里乞亞對米特拉達梯的野戰營壘挖壕築牆、填土造路，羅馬式的撞槌、箭塔與攻城塔在希臘戰線對著比雷埃夫斯與雅典的城牆使用；盧庫魯斯在最後兩年靠冬季強攻與封鎖，沿著卡帕多西亞的軍用道路北進，奪取本都的山地要塞，兵糧與攻城器械靠特拉佩祖斯等黑海港口的船隊接運。
kitsEn: The card's Roman scutum is the pivot of the equipment system in this war. By the late Republic the standard shield of the heavy infantry had already changed from the small round scutum of the early Republic into a long, slightly convex rectangle: planked timber with an iron rim and a central iron boss, roughly a metre tall, sixty to seventy-five centimetres wide and weighing about six to eight kilograms. It was carried on the left forearm, leaving the right hand free for the pilum and the short sword; because the shield is curved, neighbours in the line could lock rim to rim and build a continuous wall able to absorb a charge, while the javelin men behind threw over the top of it. The late Republican field army was still organised by manipulus, each formed by two centuries of about sixty men, so about one hundred and twenty soldiers, with ten maniples to the legion, a traditional establishment of about three thousand foot and three to six hundred horse, centuries in practice often filled to eighty men. Body armour was the mail shirt (lorica hamata); the segmented plate harness (lorica segmentata) belongs to a later age and was not yet standard. The opposing equipment was entirely Hellenic. Mithridates' phalanx infantry fought with the sarissa, a spear of two to two and a half metres, and small round shields, and the front of his line was the Chalcidian phalanx with pikes of some six metres advanced in deep overlapping files. Pontus also hired Thracian peltasts, Iberian and Cilician archers, slingers and Galatian infantry with their long two-edged swords, and its fleet, manned by Hellenic and Cypriot sailors, carried fire-ships and shipborne artillery. On the attacking side Sulla cut a ditch, raised a circumvallation and filled a causeway against Mithridates' field camp in Cilicia, while Roman rams, siege towers and causeways were used against the walls of Piraeus and Athens in the Greek theatre. Lucullus closed the last two years with winter attacks and blockade, driving north along the Cappadocian military roads to take the hill forts of Pontus, with grain and siege train carried by sea from Black Sea ports such as Trapezus.
tactics:
雙方的打法在這六年裡不斷互相修正。羅馬這邊是共和國晚期的中隊戰術：以兩個縱隊（acies duplex，前列 hastati 負責第一波衝鋒與混戰，後列 principes 為主力，pilani 老兵守第三線或作預備）前推，兩翼以盟邦輕步兵與投射兵（velites，隨軍攜帶的輕標槍手）遮蔽騷擾，接觸時才由主力中隊逐隊投入，形成在選定一點上的局部優勢。面對卡爾基斯方陣的長矛牆，羅馬並不硬撞，而是先用投射兵消耗方陣前排、掩護兩翼騎兵與同盟步兵包抄側面；必須向前推進時則結「龜甲陣」（testudo），把凸面盾朝外合成半球，頂住弓箭與長矛的正面射擊再緩慢推進。

米特拉達梯這邊把希臘方陣當作答案：方陣縱深長、槍林密，試圖讓羅馬的盾牆無法咬合，再用數量可觀的騎兵繞擊羅馬暴露的兩翼與糧道。前八十八年他派出的希臘雇傭兵在奇里乞亞與希臘本土地區屢次遲滯羅馬行軍；希臘戰線上，他把艦隊與步兵投入比雷埃夫斯，企圖以圍城拖垮羅馬的補給，結果在沿海平地反讓蘇拉的老兵以兩翼包抄取勝（查里刻戰役，底比斯將軍查爾刻斯被俘）。羅馬的攻方手段同樣成熟：蘇拉在奇里乞亞對米特拉達梯的野戰營壘挖壕築牆、填土築路強行突破，進攻雅典與比雷埃夫斯時則築攻城塔、填壕橋。盧庫魯斯的最後兩年是消耗戰：封鎖黑海東岸、奪取山地要塞、切斷本都內陸的穀物供給，逼米特拉達梯把戰爭從攻勢改成逃亡，最後在科爾喀斯海岸收尾。補給上，羅馬的糧秣靠地中海與愛琴海港口的船隊維持，前線靠卡帕多西亞的軍用道路與每年徵召的盟邦兵員。
tacticsEn: Both sides adjusted their method continuously over those six years. Rome fought with the late Republican manipular system: two lines forward (acies duplex), the hastati in front absorbing the first shock and the mixing, the principes as the weight of the line and the pilani veterans held back as a third line or reserve, the flanks screened by allied light infantry and by skirmishers (velites) carrying light javelins, and contact made by feeding maniples in one at a time so as to achieve local superiority at a chosen point of the line. Against the pike-wall of the Chalcidian phalanx Rome did not charge: it wore down the front ranks with missiles first, covered the flanks with allied cavalry and infantry, and enveloped the sides; when it had to advance against arrows and spears it formed the testudo, the convex shields turned outward into a shell that advanced slowly under fire. Mithridates treated the Hellenic phalanx as his answer — deep files, close ranks, an attempt to stop the Roman shields from interlocking, and then masses of cavalry to strike the Roman flanks and lines of communication. In 88 BC the Greek mercenaries he employed held up Roman columns in Cilicia and in Greece, and in the Greek theatre he committed fleet and infantry against Piraeus, hoping to starve the Roman army out; in the open coastal plain he was defeated instead, his line rolled up by Sulla's veterans in an enveloping movement, the battle of Charicea, in which the Theban commander Charicles was taken prisoner. The Roman siege methods matured in the same period: Sulla's circumvallation and causeway against Mithridates' field camp in Cilicia, siege towers and causeway approaches against Athens and Piraeus. Lucullus's last two years were a war of attrition, sealing the eastern Black Sea shore, taking the hill fortresses and cutting the grain of the Pontic interior, until Mithridates changed from offensive to fugitive operations and the war ended on the coast of Colchis. On the logistics side Rome's army lived off grain shipped from Mediterranean and Aegean ports, moved along the Cappadocian military roads, and was reinforced by allied contingents levied each season.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，但有幾個固定點。戰役本身：一般把第二次米特拉達梯戰爭定在前八十八至八十三年，若把梅特盧斯的前期作戰算入則可上溯至前八十九年，羅馬方面的軍事行動延續約六年，期間有過兩次跨越小亞細亞的遠征和一次渡海進入希臘。編制方面，共和國晚期的軍團理論上是十個中隊，每中隊約一百二十人（由兩個各約六十人的百人隊組成），全軍團約三千步兵，另有三百至六百騎兵；輔助軍兵力與公民軍團相當，實戰時常按兩倍徵召。蘇拉的野戰部隊，史料所載人數在一萬五千上下，另有艦隊與海軍陸戰隊隨行，若以三個軍團主力計則與此相近。前八十八年提格拉河之戰，蘇拉宣稱斬首約兩萬名敵軍；羅馬方面的損失沒有可靠記錄，只能知道追擊途中因酷熱、缺水與疫病而大量減員，這也是他不敢追擊提格拉涅斯的原因之一。希臘方面，前八十八年米特拉達梯派往愛琴海與阿提卡的艦隊，史料所記約八十艘，隨行有雇傭兵與海軍陸戰隊；前八十六年襲擊德洛斯島商港的也是這支艦隊，該港是黑海穀物、埃及小麥與東方金屬的集散地，被劫之後愛琴海航運價格急升，羅馬的海上補給線受牽動。路程上，蘇拉自奇里乞亞取道里西亞、卡里亞進入希臘，之後又由比雷埃夫斯渡海至色雷斯前線再折回小亞細亞，全程以海運與盟邦徵召維持；盧庫魯斯最後兩年沿卡帕多西亞的軍用道路北推，奪取的城市與要塞，史料只提到數座堡壘而無清單。損失數字則完全不可靠：亞美尼亞與本都方面的損失多出自羅馬將領的自述，羅馬方面的損失則因涉及政治責任而被壓低，雙方留下的數字都不能當作精確值使用。
dataEn: Few of the figures can be checked, but several fixed points hold. The war itself is conventionally dated from 88 to 83 BC, or from 89 BC if Metellus' preliminary operations are counted, and the Roman military effort ran about six years, with two campaigns across Asia Minor and one crossing into Greece. On establishments: the late Republican legion was theoretically ten maniples, each about one hundred and twenty men (two centuries of some sixty), giving roughly three thousand infantry to the legion, with three to six hundred cavalry; auxiliary troops were notionally equal to the citizen legions and in practice raised at double that number. Sulla's field force is given in the sources at around fifteen thousand men, with a fleet and marines attached, which is on the order of three legions. At the battle of the Tigris in 88 BC Sulla claimed about twenty thousand of the enemy killed; no reliable figure exists for Roman losses, though the pursuit cost him heavily through heat, thirst and disease, which is why he did not press on after Tigranes. On the Greek side the squadron Mithridates sent into the Aegean and Attica in 88 BC is recorded at about eighty ships with mercenaries and marines, and the force that raided the market island of Delos in 86 BC belonged to that same fleet; the emporium, where Black Sea grain, Egyptian wheat and eastern metals changed hands, was looted, after which Aegean freight rates rose sharply and Roman sea supply was affected. On distances: Sulla marched from Cilicia through Lycia and Caria into Greece, and later crossed from Piraeus towards the Thracian front and back into Asia Minor, sustaining himself by sea transport and allied levies; Lucullus in the last two years pushed north along the Cappadocian military roads, and the sources name a number of towns and forts taken but give no list. Loss figures are simply not reliable: Armenian and Pontic losses rest on the self-reporting of Roman commanders, while Roman losses were understated for reasons of political responsibility, and neither side's numbers should be used as precise values.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是羅馬在小亞細亞的利益與新規則。羅馬在一世紀上半葉已把比提尼亞、卡帕多西亞、龐東與帕加馬一帶的秩序寫進自己的條約：前九十一至八十八年間，龐提亞王米特拉達梯藉口「王位繼承」把卡帕多西亞王阿里奧巴匝涅斯逐出，羅馬元老院承認阿里奧巴匝涅斯為王，等於宣告本都不得插手那裡；米特拉達梯反過來把兩個兒子分別立為卡帕多西亞王與提格拉諾塞達的國王，又把加爾比斯、奇里乞亞的港口與島嶼收進版圖，等於一次性否定羅馬的安排。中間一層是亞美尼亞的介入。提格拉涅斯二世在前面幾十年已把上美索不達米亞、索利與奇里乞亞大片土地奪去，前八十八年前後更進軍敘利亞，羅馬擔心一旦本都與亞美尼亞聯手，愛琴海與黑海東岸的希臘城邦會被逐出羅馬的勢力範圍。最內裡一層是直接導火線：羅馬元老院派出的使節（包括時任執政官的蘇拉本人）要求米特拉達梯撤出卡帕多西亞與提格拉諾塞達、歸還被他奪去的加爾比斯、召回在希臘的部隊，並釋放被扣的羅馬俘虜；使節團被殺，羅馬的在地指揮官梅特盧斯又被龐提亞將軍阿卡勞斯壓制，戰爭遂在八十八年全面爆發。蘇拉接手時面對的不是一場可控的邊境衝突，而是一場橫跨小亞細亞、黑海與希臘的多戰區戰爭。
causeEn: There are three layers to the cause. The outermost is Roman interest and Roman rules in Asia Minor. Through the first half of the second century BC Rome had written its own arrangements for Bithynia, Cappadocia, Pontus and Pergamon into treaty form; between 91 and 88 BC Mithridates of Pontus, invoking a claim to a disputed succession, expelled Ariobarzanes from Cappadocia, and the Senate recognised Ariobarzanes as king, which declared that Pontus would not lay hands there. Mithridates answered by installing two sons as kings of Cappadocia and of Tigranocerta, and by taking Albia, the Cilician ports and the islands into his own hands, cancelling the Roman arrangement in one stroke. The middle layer is Armenian involvement: Tigranes II had already taken Upper Mesopotamia, Sophene and great parts of Cilicia in the preceding decades and had campaigned into Syria, and Rome feared that a Pontic-Armenian combination would push the Greek cities of the Aegean and the eastern Black Sea out of the Roman sphere. The innermost layer is the immediate cause: the envoys the Senate sent to demand that Mithridates withdraw from Cappadocia and Tigranocerta, give back the Albia he had seized, recall his troops from Greece and release the Roman prisoners he held, were killed; the Roman commander in the field, Metellus, was in turn held in check by the Pontic general Archelaus, and the war opened in full in 88 BC. What Sulla inherited was not a manageable frontier clash but a multi-front war spanning Asia Minor, the Black Sea and Greece.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠遠超出小亞細亞本身。第一，羅馬第一次以遠征軍的規模在亞洲大陸連續作戰，並且靠海運與盟邦徵召維持，這套做法此後成為共和國對外戰爭的常態，也把亞細亞的行省化從理想變成日程：卡帕多西亞重新成為羅馬的附庸，龐提亞的海岸據點交給羅馬的盟友與駐軍管理。第二，希臘的自由被提前終結。米特拉達梯以「解放希臘」為號召，一度吸引雅典與底比斯，但戰爭拖下去只留下關卡與駐軍；德洛斯商港被劫，前八十七年之後愛琴海的小麥與穀物價格長期高企，希臘商船的航線避開戰區。第三，共和國內部的裂痕被這場戰爭撕開：蘇拉為取得戰爭指揮權而率軍向羅馬進逼，隨後在八十二至七十九年間的內戰與政治清洗中，公民權遭剝奪與株連席捲意大利全境，共和國的憲政慣例至此斷裂，軍人政治成為常態。第四，戰爭並未真正了結：羅馬在亞細亞留下的開放線頭，讓龐培在前六十七年的清剿海盜戰役中接手海上任務，又在前六十五至六十三年對提格拉涅斯開戰；提格拉涅斯於前五十五年去世後，本都成為羅馬的內附國，直到前六十三年米特拉達梯被自己的兒子馬卡尼達斯所殺，這條線才真正收尾。對武器史而言，這幾年也把羅馬的方陣盾定型：它從共和國早期那面圓盾一路演變成凸面長方盾，並在隨後兩百年成為帝國步兵的標準配備。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond Asia Minor. First, Rome for the first time fought a sustained campaign on the Asian continent, sustained by sea transport and allied levies, and that pattern of war became the Republic's standing practice, turning the provincialisation of Asia from an idea into a programme: Cappadocia went back to being a Roman client, and the Pontic ports on the coast passed to Roman allies and garrisons. Second, Greek freedom was ended early. Mithridates had called for the liberation of the Greeks and had won Athens and Thebes, but all the war left behind were tolls and garrisons; the market island of Delos was plundered, and after 87 BC Aegean grain and wheat prices stayed high for years as Greek shipping avoided the war zone. Third, the war tore open the seams of the Republic at home: Sulla marched on Rome to obtain the command, and in the civil war and political purge of 82 to 79 BC the stripping of citizenship and the denunciations spread across Italy; constitutional precedent was broken and military politics became normal. Fourth, the war was never truly finished. The open flank Rome left in Asia gave Pompey the naval task of sweeping out the pirates in 67 BC and the war against Tigranes in 65 to 63 BC; after Tigranes died in 55 BC, Pontus became a Roman client state, and the thread only closed when Mithridates was killed by his own son Machanidas in 63 BC. For the history of arms the war also fixed the Roman scutum in its final form: the round shield of the early Republic became the long convex rectangle, and stayed the standard equipment of imperial infantry for the two centuries that followed.
result: 結果分三段。第一段是蘇拉的階段：前八十八年提格拉河之戰，聯軍的亞美尼亞騎兵與步兵被擊潰，提格拉涅斯退回亞美尼亞本土，羅馬第一次在安納托利亞站穩陣腳；同年冬天蘇拉渡海進入希臘，奪回比雷埃夫斯與雅典，前八十六年在查里刻擊敗米特拉達梯與底比斯的聯軍，隨後劫掠德洛斯商港；前八十七年蘇拉在奇里乞亞包圍米特拉達梯的野戰營壘，最終逼出和約——米特拉達梯放棄帕夫拉戈尼亞、加拉梯亞、卡帕多西亞王位與提格拉諾塞達，把兒子交出作人質並支付賠償，希臘方面的聯軍被解散，蘇拉則與提格拉涅斯單獨議和，讓亞美尼亞保留國土。第二段是持久戰：和約之後本都仍在卡帕多西亞境內遊擊，羅馬先後換將，前八十五年由盧庫魯斯接掌；盧庫魯斯拒絕在未經元老院批准下與提格拉涅斯締約，之後兩年把戰場推入本都內陸，奪取山地要塞，封鎖黑海東岸的糧道。第三段是收尾：前八十三年米特拉達梯遣長子馬卡里亞斯前往談判，馬卡里亞斯在爭取不到條件後自殺，盧庫魯斯隨後攻入本都，米特拉達梯帶著家屬與部將卡利迪烏斯逃往科爾喀斯；同年元老院與提格拉涅斯議和，盧庫魯斯奉召回國。結果是本都淪為羅馬的附庸與內附國，卡帕多西亞重歸阿里奧巴匝涅斯，羅馬的旗幟第一次固定在黑海東岸；米特拉達梯本人仍保有本都王位與塞浦路斯，這筆帳留給了前七十四年開始的第三次米特拉達梯戰爭。羅馬的方陣盾在這六年中沒有被任何希臘式裝備取代，反而隨著勝仗擴大為帝國步兵的制式盾牌。
resultEn: The outcome came in three stages. The first was Sulla's: at the Tigris in 88 BC the Armenian horse and foot of the coalition were broken and Tigranes withdrew into his own highlands, and Rome stood firm in Anatolia for the first time; that winter Sulla crossed to Greece, retook Piraeus and Athens, defeated the Mithridatic and Theban army at Charicea in 86 BC and then plundered the emporium of Delos; in 87 BC he surrounded Mithridates' field camp in Cilicia and forced a peace, Mithridates giving up Paphlagonia, Galatia, the kingship of Cappadocia and Tigranocerta, handing over his sons as hostages and paying an indemnity, the Greek coalition being dissolved, while Sulla made a separate peace with Tigranes and left Armenia with its own territory. The second stage was attrition: after the peace Pontus still harried the Roman lines inside Cappadocia, Rome changed commanders, and in 85 BC Lucullus took over; he refused to conclude a separate peace with Tigranes without Senate approval, and over the next two years drove the war into the interior of Pontus, taking the hill fortresses and sealing the grain routes of the eastern Black Sea. The third stage was the close: in 83 BC Mithridates sent his elder son Macharias to negotiate, and Macharias killed himself when no terms could be had; Lucullus then entered Pontus and Mithridates fled with his household and his general Calidius to Colchis; that year the Senate made peace with Tigranes and Lucullus was ordered home. The result was that Pontus became a client and dependent kingdom of Rome, Cappadocia returned to Ariobarzanes, and the Roman flag was fixed for the first time on the eastern Black Sea. Mithridates himself still kept the throne of Pontus and Cyprus, and that account was left to the Third Mithridatic War which began in 74 BC. The Roman scutum was not displaced by any Hellenic weapon during those six years; on the contrary it grew with the victories into the standard shield of imperial infantry.
